name: Question 4
problem:
Let $V={R}_{2}[t],$ the vector space of polynomials of degree at most $2$ with real coefficients. Given that the inner product on $V$ is defined as 

$$
⟨p(t),q(t)⟩=p(-1)q(-1)+p(0)q(0)+p(1)q(1),
$$

find the distance between $p(t)=5{t}^{2}-5$ and the subspace spanned by $q(t)=t+1$ with respect to the inner product.
worked_solution:
The orthogonal projection of $p(t)$ onto $\text{Span}{q(t)}$ is given by

$$
\begin{aligned}{\text{proj}}_{q(t)}\,p(t) & =\frac{⟨p(t),q(t)⟩}{⟨q(t),q(t)⟩}\,q(t) \\  & =\frac{p(-1)q(-1)+p(0)q(0)+p(1)q(1)}{q(-1)q(-1)+q(0)q(0)+q(1)q(1)}\cdot q(t) \\  & =\frac{{\sum }_{i\in {-1,0,1}}(5{t}^{2}-5){|}_{t=i}\cdot (t+1){|}_{t=i}}{{\sum }_{i\in {-1,0,1}}(t+1){|}_{t=i}\cdot (t+1){|}_{t=i}}\cdot (t+1) \\  & =\frac{0\cdot 0+(-5)\cdot 1+0\cdot 2}{0\cdot 0+1\cdot 1+2\cdot 2}\cdot (t+1) \\  & =\frac{-5}{5}\cdot (t+1) \\  & =-t-1.\end{aligned}
$$

 

The distance between $p(t)=5{t}^{2}-5$ and the subspace spanned by $q(t)=t+1$ with respect to our inner product is

$$
\begin{aligned}d & =‖p(t)-{\text{proj}}_{q(t)}\,p(t)‖ \\  & =‖5{t}^{2}-5-(-t-1)‖ \\  & =‖5{t}^{2}+t-4‖ \\  & =\sqrt{⟨5{t}^{2}+t-4,5{t}^{2}+t-4⟩}.\end{aligned}
$$

Computing the inner product, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}⟨5{t}^{2}+t-4,5{t}^{2}+t-4⟩ & ={\sum }_{i\in {-1,0,1}}(5{t}^{2}+t-4){|}_{t=i}\cdot (5{t}^{2}+t-4){|}_{t=i} \\  & =(0)\cdot (0)+(-4)\cdot (-4)+2\cdot 2 \\  & =0+16+4 \\  & =20.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the distance is $d=\sqrt{20}.$

EXPLANATION

The orthogonal projection of p(t) onto Span{q(t)} is given by

projq(t)p(t)=⟨p(t),q(t)⟩⟨q(t),q(t)⟩q(t)=p(−1)q(−1)+p(0)q(0)+p(1)q(1)q(−1)q(−1)+q(0)q(0)+q(1)q(1)⋅q(t)=∑i∈{−1,0,1}(5t2−5)|t=i⋅(t+1)|t=i∑i∈{−1,0,1}(t+1)|t=i⋅(t+1)|t=i⋅(t+1)=0⋅0+(−5)⋅1+0⋅20⋅0+1⋅1+2⋅2⋅(t+1)=−55⋅(t+1)=−t−1.

The distance between p(t)=5t2−5 and the subspace spanned by q(t)=t+1 with respect to our inner product is

d=‖p(t)−projq(t)p(t)‖=‖5t2−5−(−t−1)‖=‖5t2+t−4‖=⟨5t2+t−4,5t2+t−4⟩.

Computing the inner product, we get

⟨5t2+t−4,5t2+t−4⟩=∑i∈{−1,0,1}(5t2+t−4)|t=i⋅(5t2+t−4)|t=i=(0)⋅(0)+(−4)⋅(−4)+2⋅2=0+16+4=20.

Therefore, the distance is d=20.
